_meta.description: Collection catalog. Each collection defines a grid and references images by their stable IDs from images.json.
_meta.cellOrder: Cells are listed row by row, left to right. Use the string "blank" for an empty (black) cell.
_meta.size: x is the row count and y is the column count. Both must be from 1 through 5, and cells must contain exactly x * y values.
_meta.audioUrl: Optional HTTP(S) URL for background music; use null when the collection has no song. Playback is user-initiated.
